Appraiser remarks
The front bumper coevr is cracked and displaced on the driver side, with the upper
radiator support bracket bent and the hood latch assembly deformed. The headlamp
housing is cracked at its mounting points, and the grille retainers are broken. The
pattern of crush and paint transfer lines up with the reported frontal contact at low
speed, and nothing I observed points to earlier damage on this vehicle. The repair plan
replaces the bumper cover, bracket, latch and headlamp, then refinishes and
recalibrates the sensor mounts. The labor hours on the estimate are consistent with
the work described, and the parts and charges on the invoices show no repeated entries.
